description:
Several units' text in one call: a norm and what it relies on.

`units` answers each URN in order as `get_unit_fulltext` would, sharing one
`max_chars`: a unit that does not fit is `truncated` with a `next_cursor`, and
units past the budget come back with no text. A URN matching nothing is its
own 'not_found' entry.

urns.description: Unit URNs, answered in this order.

name: ua_law__get_units_fulltext
title: Get Several Legal Provisions' Text
